d: With the South Africa v Australia Tests going on, LSG head coach Justin Langer has reopened the Sandpapergate debate with a claim that Steve Smith, David Warner and Cameron Bancroft paid the price for cricketers across the world. He believes reverse swing has suffered since Australia's 2018 ball-tampering scandal, but does the argument really hold up? With reverse swing still very much part of cricket, is this a genuine defence of three players or another case of Australian cricket playing the victim? Rupha Ramani dissects Langer's controversial claim, Australia's cricketing hypocrisy and…
